observations: Photo 0: A black mirrorless camera body with a lens attached, shot against a blue velvet backdrop. 'LUMIX' is legible on the body front, and a single letter 'G' badge is visible near the lens mount area, but no full model number (e.g. '7') is clearly legible at this resolution.
Photo 0: Mode dial, hot shoe, and grip are visible, consistent with a Panasonic Lumix G-series mirrorless body.
Photo 1: The rear flip-out LCD screen is open and displays a 'Please set the clock' prompt, suggesting the camera powers on and the screen functions.
Photo 1: One battery and one charger unit (with 'LUMIX' branding) are visible beside the camera. A second battery is not visible in either photo.
No shots of the lens mount markings, serial number plate, memory card slot, shutter button closeup, or any zoom/autofocus test are provided.
Watermark text 'POSTED ON JIJI' and a name overlay are visible on both photos; these are platform/watermark artifacts, not proof of anything about the item.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'LUMIX' and a 'G' badge, but no legible model number such as '7' to confirm G7 specifically versus other G-series bodies (G6, G8, G80, G85, G9, etc.).
Exterior in photo 0 looks clean with no visible major scratches or dents, but internal condition (shutter count, sensor dust, mechanical wear) cannot be judged from photos.

claims.claim: Comes with 2 batteries and a charger
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows only one battery and one charger unit; no second battery is visible in either photo.
Photo 1 shows a 'Please set the clock' prompt on the LCD, which suggests the body powers up, but no video or shot of actual image capture, autofocus, or shutter operation is shown.

risks.risk: Exact model unconfirmed, and Lumix G-series models vary widely in sensor, video specs, and resale value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number plate on the top or front of the body
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-value plausible G-series body matching the visible body shape

risks.proof: A photo or screenshot of the shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with unknown shutter life remaining

risks.risk: Lens autofocus, zoom ring, and aperture function unverified
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the lens autofocusing and zooming smoothly
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown / possibly faulty

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, dead pixels) unverified
risks.proof: A photo taken by the camera of a plain white/blue sky background to check for sensor spots
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unverified, worst case has visible spots

risks.risk: Second battery claimed but not shown; battery health of shown battery unverified
risks.proof: A photo showing both batteries side by side, and a screenshot of battery charge-cycle/health indicator if available
risks.if_unproven: priced as only one battery included, with unknown battery health

risks.risk: Memory card slot and ports (HDMI, USB) condition unverified
risks.proof: A photo of the open card/port door showing the slot and port pins

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model name plate (top or front) showing the full model number
Photo showing both batteries together with the charger
Short video of the camera powering on, lens autofocusing/zooming, and a test shot being taken
Photo of a test image taken against a plain bright background to check sensor for dust/spots
Photo of the open battery/card compartment and port doors
response.reason: The seller's claimed model (G7) is not clearly legible in the photos, and the model is the primary driver of price for a Lumix G-series body; a second battery claimed is also not shown. Without a clear model plate shot, even a worst-case price cannot be set with confidence.
